title: Zhipu AI GLM 5.2 is now a legacy model
body: [GLM 5.2](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#glm-5-2) is now a [legacy](/aws/en/machine-learning/retired-models-policy) model. Databricks recommends migrating to [GLM 5.3](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#glm-5-3) or [GLM 5.3 Flash](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#glm-5-3-flash).
